messages:
ivy: quick bring-up note: deployed ivy-embed-int6 (per-channel + symmetric clipping) to staging. ran our standard anchor holdout and a cohort split by query length.
raja: nice. headline numbers?
ivy: baseline (opal-embed-v1 float16): R@1=0.490 R@5=0.724 R@10=0.812.
ivy: ivy-int6: R@1=0.461 R@5=0.705 R@10=0.780. drop concentrated on very short queries.
leo: did you check norms / per-dim shift?
ivy: median L2 norm down 5.2% for short cohort, per-dim std compressed ~10% in first 64 dims.
sofia: cluster tests? silhouette / purity?
ivy: kmeans(40) on UMAP -> silhouette dropped 0.08 overall; short-query label-precision@1 fell from 0.58 -> 0.49.
eval-bot: diagnostic: median cosine delta -0.013 for 400 affected short queries. many top-1 flips are to broader paraphrases rather than incorrect intents.
raja: sounds like calibration/scale issue. experiments?
ivy: launching three quick variants: A) per-dim affine rescale learned on 3k short-query calibration set; B) int6 + small fp16 fallback for first projection; C) clip thresholds recomputed with per-cohort optimizer.
leo: recommend also trying a 1-step linear map (least-squares) from quant->float on calibration set to test if simple L transforms fix rank.
ivy: good call — adding D) LSQ map. each run will report recall@k, silhouette, label-precision@1.
deploy-bot: ivy-int6 deployed to staging-pool-3 (tag ivy-2026-03-28-14:07).
ivy: initial A run complete: R@10 improves to 0.799 (vs 0.780), short label-precision@1 up to 0.53, silhouette recovered ~0.03. seems promising. uploading CSV of 30 exemplars.
sofia: if A generalizes to medium queries too, consider runtime post-quant hook to apply affine rescale. cheap and reversible.
raja: agree. if LSQ (D) outperforms A, we should evaluate storage/latency tradeoff for storing a small matrix vs broadcast rescale params.
ivy: continuing B & D runs now. will post full numbers + exemplar pairs when done. :mag_right:
